subject.title: Telegram forum: no reliable topic-name -> topic_id resolution for agent routing

question: Should OpenClaw expose Telegram forum topic lookup by human-readable name for agent routing, and should that be a cached context map, a message action, or a channel metadata endpoint?
rationale: The remaining work creates a public agent/tool routing contract with ambiguity, freshness, and Telegram API limitations, so automation should not choose the permanent surface or failure semantics alone.

options.title: Add Plugin-Owned Lookup Action
options.body: Expose a Telegram topic lookup/list action backed by the existing cache and create/edit observations, returning explicit ambiguous, stale, or missing results before any send.

options.title: Inject Cached Topic Map
options.body: Provide a bounded `forum_topics` map in forum-session context so agents can resolve known topic names without adding a new action.

options.title: Keep Numeric IDs Only
options.body: Document numeric topic ids as the supported routing contract and avoid title-based routing until a stronger upstream API or maintainer-approved catalog exists.

recommendation.title: Add Plugin-Owned Lookup Action
recommendation.body: Expose a Telegram topic lookup/list action backed by the existing cache and create/edit observations, returning explicit ambiguous, stale, or missing results before any send.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a public action/routing surface decision, and steipete is the strongest available routing owner from adjacent channel-action history and related review context.
